explanation: Induction on time for the invariant: no slot is alive on its own z. Class-covered steps move aliveness on z to an old slot of the same class (same z). For a cover flip at L < l, the cover is nonempty at every non-pinned level below l, so by the invariant it must fail on z(c) at a pinned level j <= L. If j < L, the flipped slot agrees with c there and is not alive on z either. If j = L, then b differs from v_L, the new slot and the old one have the same class (L is pinned) and agree on z, contradicting the invariant for the old slot.
